MORE:
Pursuant to Regulation 30 and Regulation 33 read with Schedule III of SEBI (LODR) Regulation 2015, we are pleased to inform you that the boards of directors of Terraform Realstate Limited (the company) at their meeting held on Thursday, July 16 2026 at 11: 30 am and concluded at 1:00 PM have considered and approved the following business :
1. Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the First Quarter ended June 30, 2026. 
2. Took note of limited review report of the statutory auditors of the company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
NEWSSUB: Outcome Of Board Meeting And Disclosure Under SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
